en.title: Microsoft Copilot: Your AI companion
en.description: Microsoft Copilot is your companion to inform, entertain and inspire. Get advice, feedback and straightforward answers. Try Copilot now.
en.detail:
### What is Microsoft Copilot?

Microsoft Copilot is an AI‑powered digital assistant integrated across Microsoft 365 apps such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and more. Leveraging large language models (LLMs) like OpenAI’s GPT‑4, Copilot helps users generate content, analyze data, automate repetitive tasks, and boost productivity—all within the familiar Microsoft environment. Whether you’re drafting an email, creating a presentation, or summarizing a meeting, Copilot acts as a real‑time collaborator that understands context and delivers intelligent suggestions.

### Feature Highlights

- ### Context‑aware content generation – Write emails, reports, and presentations with AI‑driven suggestions that match your tone and style.  
- ### Data insights & analysis – Turn raw numbers in Excel into visual insights, forecasts, and natural‑language summaries.  
- ### Meeting summarization – Automatically generate concise meeting minutes and action items from Teams recordings.  
- ### Creative design assistance – Generate PowerPoint slides, design layouts, and visual assets with a single prompt.  
- ### Workflow automation – Build custom Power Automate flows using natural language commands.  
- ### Secure and compliant – Operates under Microsoft’s enterprise‑grade security, privacy, and compliance standards.  
- ### Cross‑app integration – Seamlessly works across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, and more.

### How to Use Microsoft Copilot

1. ### Enable Copilot – In Microsoft 365 admin center, turn on Copilot for your organization or individual account.  
2. ### Access within apps – Look for the Copilot icon or “Ask Copilot” button in the ribbon or chat pane of supported apps.  
3. ### Enter a prompt – Type natural‑language instructions (e.g., “Create a project status slide with these metrics”) and hit Enter.  
4. ### Review & edit – Copilot generates draft content; you can accept, modify, or request refinements.  
5. ### Leverage shortcuts – Use voice commands in Teams or Outlook for hands‑free assistance.  
6. ### Iterate – Ask follow‑up questions to refine results, add data, or change formatting.

### Pricing & Subscription Options

| Plan | Who it’s for | Key Benefits | Approx. Cost* |
|------|--------------|--------------|---------------|
| ### Microsoft 365 Business Basic | Small businesses & startups | Core Office apps + limited Copilot features | $6/user / month |
| ### Microsoft 365 Business Standard | Growing teams | Full Office suite + Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint | $12.50/user / month |
| ### Microsoft 365 E3/E5 | Enterprise & regulated industries | Advanced security, compliance, and full Copilot across all apps | $32–$57/user / month |
| ### Copilot Add‑on (optional) | Organizations needing extra AI capacity | Higher usage limits, priority support, custom model tuning | Starting at $15/user / month |

\*Pricing varies by region and contract length. Check the official Microsoft 365 pricing page for the latest rates.

### Helpful Tips for Getting the Most Out of Copilot

- ### Be specific – The more detail you provide in your prompt, the better the output (e.g., “Create a 5‑slide deck on Q2 sales trends with bar charts”).  
- ### Use placeholders – Insert “[Company Name]” or “[Date]” to let Copilot auto‑populate dynamic fields.  
- ### Leverage “Regenerate” – If the first draft isn’t perfect, click “Regenerate” for alternative suggestions.  
- ### Combine with Power Automate – Chain Copilot’s output into automated workflows for end‑to‑end efficiency.  
- ### Stay privacy‑aware – Review Microsoft’s data handling policies; sensitive data can be excluded from AI processing via admin settings.  
- ### Explore templates – Copilot offers pre‑built templates for common tasks like budgeting, project plans, and newsletters.  
- ### Utilize voice in Teams – Speak naturally to generate meeting notes or action items without typing.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Do I need a separate Copilot license?  
A: Copilot is bundled with most Microsoft 365 plans, but high‑volume or enterprise users may need an additional Copilot add‑on for expanded usage.

### Q: Is my data safe when using Copilot?  
A: Yes. Microsoft processes data in compliance with GDPR, ISO 27001, and other standards. Data used for AI generation is not stored for training unless explicitly opted‑in.

### Q: Can Copilot work offline?  
A: Copilot requires an internet connection to access the cloud‑based AI models. Offline functionality is limited to standard Office features.

### Q: How many requests can I make per day?  
A: Usage limits depend on your subscription tier. Business Basic users have a lower quota, while Enterprise plans enjoy higher or unlimited request caps.

### Q: Does Copilot support multiple languages?  
A: Copilot currently supports over 30 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, and Japanese.

### Q: Can I customize Copilot’s tone or brand voice?  
A: Yes. Admins can set organization‑wide style guidelines, and users can fine‑tune prompts to match brand language.

### Q: What happens if I exceed my usage limit?  
A: You’ll receive a notification and can either wait for the quota to reset or upgrade to a higher tier/add‑on for additional capacity.

### Q: Is there a free trial?  
A: Microsoft often offers a 30‑day trial for eligible Microsoft 365 plans, allowing you to test Copilot features before committing.
